extensions.extractionNotes: DESIGN.md frontmatter owns the primitives. studio.css loads after the shell and engine base styles; its overrides define this world. Snippet fallbacks are actual source values. Tonal ramps are synthesized OKLCH display aids at fixed hue/chroma, not implemented CSS tokens or new normative palette values.

components.css: .ds-primary{font:600 13px/1.45 Plex,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;background:var(--accent,#246b50);color:var(--on-accent,#fff);border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:8px;padding:9px 18px;min-height:36px;min-width:150px;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 140ms ease,color 140ms ease,box-shadow 180ms var(--ease,cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)),transform 180ms var(--ease,cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1))}.ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--accent,#246b50);filter:brightness(1.08)}.ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled){box-shadow:0 2px 5px #172c3810}.ds-primary:active:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(1px) scale(.98)}.ds-primary:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#246b50);outline-offset:3px}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-primary{min-height:44px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary{animation:none!important;transition:none!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important}}

components.name: Model tool island
components.description: Four model tools share selection, followed by one unified Undo action.
components.css: .ds-toolstrip{display:inline-flex;gap:4px;padding:5px;background:var(--panel,#fff);border-radius:12px;box-shadow:var(--studio-shadow,0 4px 18px #172c3810)}.ds-tool{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:7px 10px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:transparent;color:var(--muted,#626c73);font:500 12px/1.5 Plex,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;white-space:nowrap;min-height:36px;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 140ms ease,color 140ms ease,box-shadow 180ms var(--ease,cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)),transform 180ms var(--ease,cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1))}.ds-tool[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--soft,#e8f2ed);color:var(--accent,#246b50)}.ds-tool:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--panel2,#f3f5f6)}.ds-tool svg{width:17px;height:17px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.6;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.ds-tool.ds-undo{border-left:1px solid var(--line,#e1e5e8);border-radius:0 7px 7px 0;margin-left:3px;min-width:36px}.ds-tool:hover:not(:disabled){box-shadow:0 2px 5px #172c3810}.ds-tool:active:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(1px) scale(.98)}.ds-tool:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}.ds-tool:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#246b50);outline-offset:3px}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-toolstrip{padding:4px;gap:2px}.ds-tool{min-height:44px;min-width:44px;font-size:11px;padding:6px 8px;gap:5px}.ds-tool.ds-undo{min-width:44px}}@media(max-width:560px){.ds-tool{padding:6px 10px}.ds-tool svg{display:none}.ds-undo svg{display:block}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-tool{animation:none!important;transition:none!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important}}

narrative.overview:
This document governs only `experiments/workbench`, the separate **v2.6.30-test** interface and its `dist-workbench` build. The production `web` UI retains its incumbent system. These tokens do not authorise production restyling. The approved surface direction is recorded in `experiments/workbench/STUDIO-BRIEF.md`; the broader workflow contract remains in `docs/workbench-direction.md`.

A pale model canvas occupies most of the workspace. Neutral white controls, cool grey surroundings and restrained green states keep the model visually central. A compact floating tool island and a quiet contextual inspector give editing controls a stable place. IBM Plex Sans now carries headings, body copy and controls. The YAB3D name, existing mark and UK English remain the durable identity commitments from `PRODUCT.md`.
keyCharacteristics: Cool neutral-white surfaces and a large pale model canvas.
Green action, selection and focus states.
One floating model-tool island and a scrolling contextual inspector.
Compact Plex typography, modest rounded controls and soft structural shadows.

rules.name: The Shared Palette Rule
rules.body: Read the studio override as the shell and engine colour authority; do not reintroduce the superseded orange action or charcoal light-mode stage from the base stylesheets.

rules.name: The Floating Controls Rule
rules.body: Reserve soft structural elevation for controls over the canvas and transient surfaces; keep inspector groups flat.

dos: Do apply these tokens only to the separate Workbench studio.
Do preserve visible focus, selection, status and the inspector's independent scrolling.
Do keep the four model tools together and use the shared Undo action.
Do retain touch multiselection and the implemented 44px mobile targets.
Do retain the existing YAB3D mark, self-hosted Plex font and OFL licence.
Do label software-rendered previews as static and demonstration models as synthetic.
donts: Don't apply the studio palette to the production UI without a separate approved change.
Don't restore the old orange controls or charcoal light-mode stage from superseded base CSS.
Don't add duplicate action bars, decorative cards or decorative raster imagery to this workbench direction.
Don't treat model previews as proof of physical print results.
